id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_180.pack|cs_: "After losing my sister, Mia, I ran off on a journey as if fleeing. ...It was all my fault.
"On the road I found out. What I gave her wasn't a birthday gift. It was a cursed item...
"To flee my mistake and forget, I turned reckless everywhere. ...Before I knew it, I was a proper thief.
"...Then, someone calling himself the Seer told me:
"'Collect the legendary orbs and aid the Luminary you'll meet underground. Then you will be forgiven.'
"At first I didn't believe it. I'd had enough of shady types.
"But just as foretold, I met you... {var:1}.
"Sorry, old man. And {var:1}, everyone. I must have caused a lot of trouble.
"I don't know what atonement the Seer meant. But traveling with you made me feel I could believe it.
"You saw it too. My sister turned to gold should have been right here.
"Apparently a monster called Gyldygga is collecting gold around here. He probably did it...
"While captured I heard the monsters talk. Their castle is north of here. I'll storm in and take Mia back!
"We have to save the golden-statue Sniflheimers too, so we have to go. ...Right, {var:1}?
"Thanks... Please let me fight with you.
With his memory restored, Erik's Character Builder panels returned to normal!"
